# YES Hotels

> A premium boutique hotel offering thoughtfully designed rooms, bespoke hospitality, and seamless direct booking.

YES Hotels is a luxury boutique hotel providing a full-service hospitality experience. Guests can discover and book rooms directly on our website. Our property features elegantly designed suites and rooms, a dedicated front-desk team, dining facilities, and curated guest experiences.

## Key Pages

- [Home](/) — Main hotel landing page with booking bar
- [Rooms & Suites](/rooms) — Browse all available room categories
- [Room Details](/rooms/:slug) — Detailed view of each room type with amenities, pricing, and 3D preview
- [Book Now](/search) — Search availability and book a room directly online
- [About Us](/about) — The YES Hotels story and hospitality philosophy
- [Gallery](/gallery) — Photo gallery of rooms, dining, exteriors, and amenities
- [FAQ](/faq) — Frequently asked questions about booking, check-in, and policies
- [Contact](/contact) — Reservations desk, email, and contact form
- [Privacy Policy](/privacy-policy) — How YES Hotels handles guest data
- [Terms & Conditions](/terms-and-conditions) — Booking terms
- [Cancellation & Refund Policy](/cancellation-and-refund) — Cancellation rules

## Hotel Information

- **Brand**: YES Hotels
- **Type**: Luxury Boutique Hotel
- **Direct Booking**: Available at /search
- **Check-in**: 14:00
- **Check-out**: 12:00
- **Contact Email**: reservations@yeshotels.com
- **Front Desk**: Open daily, 6:00 AM – 11:00 PM

## Booking

Direct booking is available at [/search](/search). Guests can check availability by date, select room category, enter guest details, and confirm payment securely via Razorpay.
